svg.title: Right-hand distance from the nearest virtual figure
svg.desc: Two example Crowd Avoidance recordings from 16 November 2026. With a reaching gesture the closest distance was 19 cm. While observing it was 36 cm. Measurements refer to object centres.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(9%,12%,10%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px;fill: rgb(93%,94%,90%); stroke:none;
